response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced generalist software engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js, cloud, and infrastructure skills, and recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq. However, the role requires 8+ years building production AI-driven solutions, and his AI/GenAI experience appears to span roughly one year. There is no demonstrated experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation pipelines, or multi-agent frameworks, and limited evidence of customer-facing technical discovery leadership in an AI delivery context. Worth a conversation if the pipeline is thin, but he does not meet the core AI experience bar as written.
strengths: 15+ years of production software engineering across web, backend, and high-scale distributed systems
Recent hands-on work with MCP code generators and AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: Falls well short of the 8+ years of AI/GenAI solution development requirement (~1 year of relevant work)
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent framework experience on the resume
Limited evidence of enterprise customer-facing delivery and technical discovery leadership expected of a forward deployed staff role

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering depth and cloud/TypeScript skills
Recent MCP and agentic tooling exposure
